title: Nats boss summoned by UK transport secretary as flight chaos enters second day
summary_full: Martin Rolfe, who faces pressure to resign, due to brief Heidi Alexander after cancellations pass 2,000Business live – latest updatesHow have you been affected by UK air traffic disruption?The boss of the air traffic control provider Nats has been summoned to meet the UK transport secretary as the number of flight cancellations passed 2,000 in a second day of disruption for hundreds of thousands of passengers.Martin Rolfe, who is facing increasing pressure to resign over a third major stoppage to flights in just over three years, is due to brief Heidi Alexander on Wednesday.
